question: RRB NTPC: Bal (Force) ka SI ekak kya hai?
explanation: Bal ka SI ekak Newton hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Karya (Work) aur Urja (Energy) ka SI ekak kya hai?
explanation: Karya aur Urja ka SI ekak Joule hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Shakti (Power) ka SI ekak kya hai?
explanation: Shakti ka SI ekak Watt hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Vidyut dhara (Electric Current) ka SI ekak kya hai?
explanation: Vidyut dhara ka SI ekak Ampere hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Taapmaan (Temperature) ka SI ekak kya hai?
explanation: Taapmaan ka SI ekak Kelvin hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Dabaav (Pressure) ka SI ekak kya hai?
explanation: Dabaav ka SI ekak Pascal hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Aavritti (Frequency) ka SI ekak kya hai?
explanation: Aavritti ka SI ekak Hertz hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Vidyut Pratirodh (Electric Resistance) ka ekak kya hai?
explanation: Vidyut Pratirodh ka ekak Ohm hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Vidyut Aavesh (Electric Charge) ka ekak kya hai?
explanation: Vidyut Aavesh ka ekak Coulomb hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Vidyut Vibhav (Electric Potential) ka ekak kya hai?
explanation: Vidyut Vibhav ka ekak Volt hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Nirvaat mein prakash ki chaal (speed of light) kitni hoti hai?
explanation: Nirvaat mein prakash ki chaal lagbhag 3×10^8 meter/second hoti hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Dhwani (Sound) sabse tez kis madhyam mein chalti hai?
explanation: Dhwani sabse tez Thos (solid) madhyam mein chalti hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Dhwani kis madhyam mein nahi chal sakti?
explanation: Dhwani ko chalne ke liye madhyam chahiye, isliye wah Nirvaat mein nahi chal sakti.

question: RRB NTPC: Manav kaan ki suniye jaane wali aavritti seema kya hai?
explanation: Manav kaan 20 Hz se 20000 Hz tak ki dhwani sun sakta hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Door-drishti dosh (Hypermetropia) ko theek karne ke liye kaun sa lens upyog hota hai?
explanation: Door-drishti dosh ko theek karne ke liye Uttal (Convex) Lens ka upyog hota hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Nikat-drishti dosh (Myopia) ko theek karne ke liye kaun sa lens upyog hota hai?
explanation: Nikat-drishti dosh ko theek karne ke liye Aveil (Concave) Lens ka upyog hota hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Indradhanush (Rainbow) banne ka mukhya karan kya hai?
explanation: Indradhanush prakash ke apvartan (refraction) aur vikiran (dispersion) ke karan banta hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Vahan (vehicle) ke headlight mein kaun sa darpan (mirror) upyog hota hai?
explanation: Vahan ke headlight mein Aveil (Concave) darpan upyog hota hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Vahan ke peeche dekhne wale darpan (rear-view mirror) mein kaun sa darpan upyog hota hai?
explanation: Rear-view mirror mein Uttal (Convex) darpan upyog hota hai kyunki isse chaudा drishya kshetra milta hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Ohm ka niyam kya darshata hai?
explanation: Ohm ke niyam ke anusaar V = I × R (Vibhavantar = Dhara × Pratirodh).

question: RRB NTPC: Vidyut Motor kis urja ko kis urja mein badalti hai?
explanation: Vidyut Motor Vidyut Urja ko Yantrik Urja mein badalti hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Vidyut Janak (Generator/Dynamo) kis urja ko kis urja mein badalta hai?
explanation: Generator Yantrik Urja ko Vidyut Urja mein badalta hai.

question: RRB NTPC: 1 Watt kis ke barabar hota hai?
explanation: 1 Watt = 1 Joule/second, yani prati second kiya gaya karya.

question: RRB NTPC: Gati ke niyam (Laws of Motion) kis vaigyanik ne diye the?
explanation: Gati ke teen niyam Isaac Newton ne diye the.

question: RRB NTPC: Dravyaman (Mass) ka SI ekak kya hai?
explanation: Dravyaman ka SI ekak Kilogram hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Prithvi par gurutvakarshan ke karan tvaran (g) ka lagbhag maan kya hai?
explanation: Prithvi par g ka lagbhag maan 9.8 meter/second² hota hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Gurutvakarshan tvaran ki disha kya hoti hai?
explanation: Gurutvakarshan tvaran hamesha Prithvi ke kendra ki taraf hota hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Vayumandaliya dabaav (atmospheric pressure) mapne ke liye kaun sa yantra upyog hota hai?
explanation: Vayumandaliya dabaav Barometer se mapa jata hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Taapmaan mapne ke liye kaun sa yantra upyog hota hai?
explanation: Taapmaan Thermometer se mapa jata hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Vidyut dhara mapne ke liye kaun sa yantra upyog hota hai?
explanation: Vidyut dhara Ammeter se mapi jati hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Vibhavantar (potential difference) mapne ke liye kaun sa yantra upyog hota hai?
explanation: Vibhavantar Voltmeter se mapa jata hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Saral Sukshmadarshi (Simple Microscope) mein kaun sa lens upyog hota hai?
explanation: Saral Sukshmadarshi mein Uttal (Convex) Lens ka upyog hota hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Parmanu Reaktor (Nuclear Reactor) mein urja kis prakriya se utpann hoti hai?
explanation: Parmanu Reaktar mein urja Nabhikiya Vikhandan (Nuclear Fission) se utpann hoti hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Kisi vastu ki jaadatva (inertia) kis rashi par nirbhar karti hai?
explanation: Jaadatva (Inertia) vastu ke Dravyaman (Mass) par nirbhar karti hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Ek Newton bal kis ke barabar hota hai?
explanation: 1 Newton = 1 kg×m/s², yani ek kilogram ke dravyaman ko ek meter/second² tvaran dene wala bal.

question: RRB NTPC: Kisi lens ki shakti (power) ka ekak kya hai?
explanation: Lens ki shakti Diopter mein mapi jati hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Sone (Gold) ka rasayanik prateek (chemical symbol) kya hai?
explanation: Sone ka rasayanik prateek Au hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Chandi (Silver) ka rasayanik prateek kya hai?
explanation: Chandi ka rasayanik prateek Ag hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Loha (Iron) ka rasayanik prateek kya hai?
explanation: Loha ka rasayanik prateek Fe hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Sodium ka rasayanik prateek kya hai?
explanation: Sodium ka rasayanik prateek Na hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Potassium ka rasayanik prateek kya hai?
explanation: Potassium ka rasayanik prateek K hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Aadhunik Aavart Sarni (Modern Periodic Table) ke janak kaun mane jate hain?
explanation: Dmitri Mendeleev ko Aavart Sarni ka janak mana jata hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Aadhunik Aavart Sarni mein kul kitne tatva (elements) hain?
explanation: Aadhunik Aavart Sarni mein kul 118 tatva hain.

question: RRB NTPC: Shuddh jal (pure water) ka pH maan kya hota hai?
explanation: Shuddh jal ka pH maan 7 hota hai, jo udaseen (neutral) darshata hai.

question: RRB NTPC: 7 se kam pH maan kis prakriti ko darshata hai?
explanation: 7 se kam pH maan Amliya (acidic) prakriti darshata hai.

question: RRB NTPC: 7 se adhik pH maan kis prakriti ko darshata hai?
explanation: 7 se adhik pH maan Kshariya (basic/alkaline) prakriti darshata hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Jal (Water) ka rasayanik sutra kya hai?
explanation: Jal ka rasayanik sutra H2O hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Saadha Namak (Common Salt) ka rasayanik sutra kya hai?
explanation: Saadha Namak ka rasayanik sutra NaCl (Sodium Chloride) hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Baking Soda ka rasayanik naam kya hai?
explanation: Baking Soda ka rasayanik naam Sodium Bicarbonate (NaHCO3) hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Aag bujhane wale yantra (fire extinguisher) mein kaun si gas upyog hoti hai?
explanation: Fire extinguisher mein Carbon Dioxide (CO2) gas ka upyog hota hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Vayumandal mein sabse adhik matra mein paayi jaane wali gas kaun si hai?
explanation: Vayumandal mein sabse adhik matra Nitrogen gas ki hai (lagbhag 78%).

question: RRB NTPC: Global Warming ke liye mukhya roop se kaun si gas zimmedar hai?
explanation: Carbon Dioxide (CO2) Global Warming ke liye mukhya roop se zimmedar greenhouse gas hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Hydrogen ka parmaanu kramank (atomic number) kya hai?
explanation: Hydrogen ka parmaanu kramank 1 hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Oxygen ka parmaanu kramank (atomic number) kya hai?
explanation: Oxygen ka parmaanu kramank 8 hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Sirke (vinegar) mein kaun sa amal (acid) paaya jata hai?
explanation: Sirke mein Acetic Acid paaya jata hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Nimbu (lemon) mein kaun sa amal paaya jata hai?
explanation: Nimbu mein Citric Acid paaya jata hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Dahi (curd) mein kaun sa amal paaya jata hai?
explanation: Dahi mein Lactic Acid paaya jata hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Jang (Rust) ka rasayanik naam kya hai?
explanation: Jang mukhyatah Iron Oxide (Hydrated Fe2O3) hoti hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Prakriti mein sabse kathor padarth (hardest substance) kaun sa hai?
explanation: Heera (Diamond) prakriti mein sabse kathor padarth hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Kamre ke taapmaan par kaun si dhaatu dravya (liquid) roop mein rehti hai?
explanation: Paara (Mercury) kamre ke taapmaan par dravya roop mein rehta hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Kamre ke taapmaan par kaun si adhaatu dravya (liquid) roop mein rehti hai?
explanation: Bromine kamre ke taapmaan par dravya roop mein rehta hai.

question: RRB NTPC: LPG (Liquefied Petroleum Gas) ke mukhya ghatak kya hain?
explanation: LPG mukhyatah Butane aur Propane ka mishran hoti hai.

question: RRB NTPC: CNG (Compressed Natural Gas) ka mukhya ghatak kya hai?
explanation: CNG ka mukhya ghatak Methane gas hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Sangmarmar (Marble) ka rasayanik naam kya hai?
explanation: Sangmarmar ka rasayanik naam Calcium Carbonate hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Prakash Sanshleshan (Photosynthesis) mein paudhe kaun si gas grahan karte hain?
explanation: Prakash Sanshleshan mein paudhe Carbon Dioxide grahan karte hain.

question: RRB NTPC: Prakash Sanshleshan ke dauraan paudhe kaun si gas mukt karte hain?
explanation: Prakash Sanshleshan ke dauraan paudhe Oxygen gas mukt karte hain.

question: RRB NTPC: Manav sharir mein 'Master Gland' kise kaha jata hai?
explanation: Pituitary Gland ko Master Gland kaha jata hai kyunki yeh baaki granthiyon ko niyantrit karti hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Manav sharir ki sabse badi granthi (largest gland) kaun si hai?
explanation: Liver (Yakrit) manav sharir ki sabse badi granthi hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Manav hriday (heart) mein kul kitne kaksh (chambers) hote hain?
explanation: Manav hriday mein 4 kaksh hote hain: 2 Atria aur 2 Ventricle.

question: RRB NTPC: Laal Rakt Koshikayen (Red Blood Cells) kahan banti hain?
explanation: Laal Rakt Koshikayen Asthi Majja (Bone Marrow) mein bantee hain.

question: RRB NTPC: Vitamin C ki kami se kaun sa rog hota hai?
explanation: Vitamin C ki kami se Scurvy rog hota hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Vitamin D ki kami se kaun sa rog hota hai?
explanation: Vitamin D ki kami se haddiyon ka rog Rickets hota hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Vitamin A ki kami se kya hota hai?
explanation: Vitamin A ki kami se Ratondhi (Night Blindness) hoti hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Vitamin B1 ki kami se kaun sa rog hota hai?
explanation: Vitamin B1 (Thiamine) ki kami se Beriberi rog hota hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Vitamin K sharir mein mukhyatah kis kaam ke liye zaroori hai?
explanation: Vitamin K rakt jamne (Blood Clotting) ki prakriya mein zaroori hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Manav sharir mein kul kitni haddiyan (bones) hoti hain?
explanation: Manav sharir mein kul 206 haddiyan hoti hain.

question: RRB NTPC: Manav sharir ki sabse badi haddi (bone) kaun si hai?
explanation: Femur (jaandh ki haddi) manav sharir ki sabse badi haddi hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Manav kaan ki sabse chhoti haddi kaun si hai?
explanation: Stapes manav sharir ki sabse chhoti haddi hai, jo kaan mein sthit hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Insulin hormone kis granthi se srawit hota hai?
explanation: Insulin Pancreas (Agnyashay) se srawit hota hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Madhumeh (Diabetes) rog kis hormone ki kami se hota hai?
explanation: Madhumeh (Diabetes) Insulin ki kami ya asantulan se hota hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Prakash Sanshleshan paudhon ke kis bhaag mein hota hai?
explanation: Prakash Sanshleshan patton mein sthit Chloroplast mein hota hai.

question: RRB NTPC: DNA ka poora naam kya hai?
explanation: DNA ka poora naam Deoxyribonucleic Acid hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Manav sharir mein pachan kriya (digestion) sabse pehle kahan shuru hoti hai?
explanation: Pachan kriya Mooh mein laar (saliva) ke dwara shuru hoti hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Manav sharir ka sabse bada ang (organ) kaun sa hai?
explanation: Twacha (Skin) manav sharir ka sabse bada ang hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Rakt mein Praan Vayu (Oxygen) le jaane wala pigment kaun sa hai?
explanation: Hemoglobin rakt mein Praan Vayu (Oxygen) le jaane ka kaam karta hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Malaria rog kis parjeevi (parasite) se hota hai?
explanation: Malaria rog madaa Anopheles machhar dwara failne wale Plasmodium parjeevi se hota hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Dengue rog kis machhar dwara failta hai?
explanation: Dengue rog Aedes machhar dwara failta hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Tapedik (Tuberculosis/TB) rog kis jeevanu (bacteria) se hota hai?
explanation: TB rog Mycobacterium tuberculosis naamak jeevanu se hota hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Manav pachan tantra ka sabse lamba ang kaun sa hai?
explanation: Chhoti Aant manav pachan tantra ka sabse lamba ang hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Sharir ki tantrika tantra (nervous system) ka niyantran kendra kya hai?
explanation: Mastishk (Brain) tantrika tantra ka niyantran kendra hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Prakash Sanshleshan ke liye zaroori mukhya pigment kaun sa hai?
explanation: Chlorophyll (harit lavak) Prakash Sanshleshan ke liye zaroori mukhya pigment hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Ek vayask manav ke kul kitne daant hote hain?
explanation: Ek vayask manav ke kul 32 daant hote hain.

question: RRB NTPC: Rakt ka laal rang kis padarth ki wajah se hota hai?
explanation: Rakt ka laal rang Hemoglobin mein maujood iron ki wajah se hota hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Safed Rakt Koshikayen (WBC) ka mukhya kaam kya hai?
explanation: WBC sharir ki rogon se raksha karti hain, yani unka mukhya kaam Immunity hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Manav sharir ki sabse chhoti koshika (cell) kaun si mani jati hai?
explanation: Sperm Cell ko manav sharir ki sabse chhoti koshika mana jata hai.

question: RRB NTPC: AIDS rog kis virus se hota hai?
explanation: AIDS rog HIV (Human Immunodeficiency Virus) se hota hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Paristhitik Tantra (Ecosystem) mein Khadya Shrinkhala (Food Chain) kis se shuru hoti hai?
explanation: Khadya Shrinkhala Utpadak (Producers, yani paudhon) se shuru hoti hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Ozone parat kis gas se bani hoti hai jo UV kirnon se raksha karti hai?
explanation: Ozone parat Ozone (O3) gas se bani hoti hai jo hanikarak UV kirnon se raksha karti hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Manav sharir ka saamanya (normal) taapmaan kitna hota hai?
explanation: Manav sharir ka saamanya taapmaan lagbhag 37°C (98.6°F) hota hai.

question: RRB NTPC: Manav rakt ka pH range kya hota hai?
explanation: Manav rakt halka kshariya hota hai, jiska pH range 7.35-7.45 hota hai.
